summary.text: Sarah Fowler is a Republican state representative who has represented Ohio House District 99 since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She chairs the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Fowler lives in Geneva-on-the-Lake, Ohio, and her career experience includes work as an independent consultant, a co-producer of an international YouTube channel, and the founder and owner of a business, according to Ballotpedia.
She was first elected to the Ohio State Board of Education (District 7) in a November 2012 special election, took office in January 2013, was re-elected in 2014, and served until 2020.
In the 2025-2026 session Fowler serves on the Children and Human Services, Community Revitalization, House Education (as chair) and House Local Government committees.
She defeated Democrat Louis Murphy in the 2024 general election with 64.5 percent of the vote.
